bug_description.original: Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4820171095408640 Project: libzip Fuzz Target: zip_read_fuzzer Crash Type: Heap-use-after-free READ 1 Crash State: zip_source_open -> zip_source_open -> _zip_open Sanitizer: address (ASAN).
bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json issue_description / sanitizer_trace.txt / patch.diff / reproduction_report.json / staged vulnerable checkout `_work/src/libzip`
bug_description.normalized: The exact staged 44-byte witness is an EOCD-only ZIP record whose central-directory `size` and `offset` fields are both zero and whose EOCD `comment_len` field is `0x0016`, followed by the 22-byte comment `TORRENTZIPPED-       4`. `_zip_read_eocd()` and `_zip_read_cdir()` materialize those attacker-controlled fields, so `zip_check_torrentzip()` accepts the comment as a torrentzip marker, parses `crc_should == 4`, and creates `src_window = _zip_source_window_new(za->src, 0, 0, ...)`. `zip_source_crc_create(src_window, 1, NULL)` then stores that `src_window` pointer as the lower layer of `src_crc`, but the vulnerable code immediately calls `zip_source_free(src_window)`. Because the CRC wrapper did not retain an extra reference to its lower layer, `src_crc->src` becomes a dangling pointer. `zip_source_open(src_crc)` recurses into `zip_source_open(src->src)`, and the second frame reads `src->source_closed` from the freed `src_window`, which is the saved AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free. The fix removes the extra `zip_source_free(src_window)` after successful CRC-wrapper creation.

source.description: First project statement on the witnessed vulnerable path that consumes attacker-controlled bytes and materializes the central-directory bounds later reused by `zip_check_torrentzip()` when it builds `src_window`.
source.value_from: The exact staged `poc` is a 44-byte EOCD-only ZIP record. Bytes 12-19 are all zero, so `_zip_read_eocd()` consumes them here as `size == 0` and `offset == 0`, the values later passed into `_zip_source_window_new()`.

sink.description: AddressSanitizer crash site. The recursive `zip_source_open(src->src)` on the CRC wrapper passes the freed `src_window` into a second `zip_source_open()` frame, and this read touches the freed heap object.
sink.note: The saved ASan report is `heap-use-after-free READ 1` at `zip_source_open.c:39:14` with stack `zip_source_open -> zip_source_open -> zip_check_torrentzip -> _zip_open`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. After `zip_source_crc_create()` has already stored `src_window` as the lower layer of `src_crc`, this extra free drops `src_window`'s refcount to zero and destroys the object while `src_crc->src` still points to it. The fixing commit deletes this line.
root_cause.note: The vulnerability came from an outdated ownership assumption after the layered-source API change: the CRC wrapper keeps the pointer, but it does not take a new reference to `src_window`.

tainted_value_origin.description: When `zip_source_crc_create(src_window, 1, NULL)` builds the CRC wrapper, it stores the `src_window` pointer here as the wrapper's lower layer. That field is the dangling pointer later followed by `zip_source_open(src_crc)` after `zip_check_torrentzip()` frees `src_window`.

parser_admitted.description: The staged witness reaches the vulnerable block because its EOCD comment is exactly 22 bytes, begins with `TORRENTZIPPED-`, and the trailing eight bytes `       4` pass the subsequent `strtoul(..., 16)` check, so `zip_check_torrentzip()` does not return before creating and opening `src_crc`.
parser_admitted.condition: _zip_string_length(cdir->comment) == TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE_LENGTH + TORRENTZIP_CRC_LENGTH && strncmp((const char *)cdir->comment->raw, TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE, TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE_LENGTH) == 0

coarse_trace.summary: The harness wraps the exact 44-byte witness as a buffer-backed `zip_source_t` and calls `zip_open_from_source()`; the crash happens during archive open before the entry-reading loop.
libzip parses the EOCD record, materializing `size = 0`, `offset = 0`, `comment_len = 0x0016`, and the archive comment `TORRENTZIPPED-       4` from the witness.
The torrentzip checker accepts the comment, allocates `src_window`, wraps it in `src_crc`, and then erroneously frees `src_window` even though the CRC wrapper still stores it as `src_crc->src`.
Opening the layered CRC source recursively follows the dangling lower-layer pointer and reads from the freed `src_window`, producing the saved AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free.

fine_trace.note: Source. The EOCD parser reads the attacker-controlled central-directory bounds from the witness. For this exact input both values are zero, and `_zip_read_eocd()` later returns a `zip_cdir_t` carrying those same `size` and `offset` fields into `_zip_open()`.

After `_zip_read_eocd()` succeeds, `_zip_read_cdir()` reads the attacker-controlled EOCD comment-length field. In the exact witness, bytes 20-21 are `16 00`, so `comment_len == 0x0016`; because the file is exactly 44 bytes long, the later `tail_len < comment_len` check also sees 22 remaining bytes and allows the comment copy to run.

fine_trace.code: if ((cd->comment = _zip_string_new(_zip_buffer_get(buffer, comment_len), comment_len, ZIP_FL_ENC_GUESS, error)) == NULL) {
fine_trace.note: Using the length from step 2, `_zip_buffer_get(buffer, comment_len)` copies the full EOCD tail into a heap-backed `zip_string_t`. For the staged witness, `cd->comment->raw` becomes the exact 22-byte string `TORRENTZIPPED-       4`.
The comment from step 3 satisfies both guards, so `zip_check_torrentzip()` does not return and continues down the torrentzip-validation path.

The trailing eight comment bytes `"       4"` are copied into `buf` and parsed as hexadecimal. `strtoul()` skips the leading spaces, yields `crc_should == 4`, and leaves `end` at the terminator, so the numeric-validity check does not return.

depends_on.via: _zip_string_length(cdir->comment) == TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE_LENGTH + TORRENTZIP_CRC_LENGTH && strncmp((const char *)cdir->comment->raw, TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE, TORRENTZIP_SIGNATURE_LENGTH) == 0

fine_trace.note: With `cdir->offset == 0`, `cdir->size == 0`, and `crc_should == 4`, the checker requests a window source over `za->src`. The saved ASan allocation stack shows this call allocating the 88-byte `src_window` object that later becomes the use-after-free target.

`zip_source_crc_create(src_window, 1, NULL)` reaches this assignment and stores the `src_window` pointer as the lower layer of the CRC wrapper `src_crc`. Unlike `_zip_source_window_new()`, this helper does not call `zip_source_keep(src)`, so the wrapper depends on the caller keeping `src_window` alive.

Root cause. `src_window` still has refcount 1 here, so `zip_source_free()` decrements it to zero and frees the object. The CRC wrapper from step 7 still holds the same pointer in `src_crc->src`, turning that field into a dangling lower-layer reference.

When `zip_check_torrentzip()` calls `zip_source_open(src_crc)`, the CRC wrapper is a layered source, so `zip_source_open()` recursively opens the lower-layer pointer saved in step 7. Because step 8 already freed that object, this call passes a dangling `src_window` pointer into the second `zip_source_open()` frame.

Sink. The recursive open from step 9 receives the freed `src_window` as `src` and immediately reads its `source_closed` byte. ASan records this as the 1-byte heap-use-after-free at `zip_source_open.c:39:14`, 56 bytes inside the freed 88-byte `src_window` region.

allocation_context.description: Saved ASan allocation stack: `_zip_source_window_new()` calls `zip_source_layered_create()` for the `src_window` object, which in turn allocates the 88-byte `zip_source_t` via `_zip_source_new()`.

format.name: EOCD-only ZIP
format.contract: An exact 44-byte binary ZIP end-of-central-directory record: bytes `50 4b 05 06`, then sixteen zero bytes for the disk, entry-count, central-directory-size, and central-directory-offset fields, then comment length `16 00`, then the exact 22-byte ASCII comment `TORRENTZIPPED-       4`. This exact witness makes `zip_check_torrentzip()` accept the archive comment and parse `crc_should == 4`.
